title: Episode 1 - Garage Portal (H3)

scientist.sheet_prompt: A tall, very lanky old scientist in his 70s. Spiky pale blue-grey hair sticking up in messy spikes, one single thick unibrow straight across both eyes, large round white eyes with tiny black dot pupils, a long thin face with a pointed chin, a slightly crooked nose. White lab coat over a light blue sweater, brown trousers, black shoes. Hunched, impatient posture. One thin string of drool at the corner of his mouth. Grumpy, bored, arrogant expression.

boy.sheet_prompt: A short 14-year-old boy with a large slightly oval head, wider than it is tall, sitting on a small thin body with narrow shoulders. Short brown hair drawn as one smooth rounded shape hugging the skull, swept slightly forward, with small uneven tufts at the forehead and sides. NOT a bowl cut, NOT a mushroom shape. No eyebrows drawn as solid shapes, only thin simple lines. Big perfectly round white eyes with tiny black dot pupils set close together. Small curved nose line, wavy nervous mouth line. Plain yellow short-sleeve t-shirt, blue jeans, white sneakers. Anxious, worried, uncertain expression.
